items.source: A transaction rollback has been requested.
The transaction expired at the point of trying to commit it.
items.translation: 该事务在尝试提交时已超时。

items.source: A base class of transaction-level exceptions raised by Couchbase, allowing them to be handled in one place.
items.translation: Couchbase 抛出的事务级异常的基础类，允许在统一位置处理这些异常。

items.source: The transaction failed and unambiguously did not commit.
items.translation: 该事务失败，且明确未提交。

items.source: An opaque signal that something went wrong during the execution of an operation inside a transaction.
items.translation: 表示事务内部操作执行过程中出现错误的不可见信号。
